```elixir title="Elixir"

result = LiterLlm.defaultclient_chat_async(client, "{\"max_tokens\":16,\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Say hello in one word.\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"github_copilot/gpt-4o\",\"temperature\":0}")
```
